description: The Agencia Nacional de Infraestructura (ANI) manages Colombia's infrastructure concessions and public-private partnerships for roads, railways, ports and airports, and publishes open datasets on them. Its open data page read on 2026-09-28 lists, among others, the list of ANI concession projects (updated every six months), the toll tariffs of ANI toll plazas (annual) and the vehicle traffic registered at those toll plazas, each issued on 2021-11-12 in the transport category, with national coverage and the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence; each entry links to the dataset on the national open data portal datos.gov.co, where tables are downloaded as CSV or through its API. Coverage is the national concession network managed by ANI, not all Colombian roads. Caveats: the entries on the page carry no tags and some issue dates are several years old, traffic is counted only at toll plazas, and concession geometry is not included. It supports network flow analysis of the tolled corridors, demand estimation for freight and passenger road traffic, and capacity planning of concessioned infrastructure. Related record: data-datos-abiertos-colombia is the national portal that hosts the tables.
